Parish council

The parish council looks after the green, the bus shelters, the allotments and the footpaths that cross the parish. It is made up of nine councillors, elected every four years, who give their time without pay and answer to the village. Meetings are open to the public, and there is time at the start of each one for anyone to raise a question or a concern.
